title: fix(core): a list bulk Delete with refused records says why, not only "0 deleted, 4 failed"
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuDJAbBe3iTrFcF7GZrucZ32)_

Fixes #37758

A list bulk Delete whose records were refused said only 「成功 0 条，失败 4 条」 ("0 deleted, 4 failed"). The server gives every refused record a readable, localized reason (a restrict delete says which child records still reference it), and the one-record Delete shows it; the batch summary dropped it.

## What changes

- **`@object-ui/core` (`actions/recordDelete.ts`).** The bulk branch of `run` keeps each rejected result's reason. The summary toast keeps its count title (`objectActions.bulkDeletePartial`) and gains a description:
  - one line per distinct reason, in the order the records were handed in;
  - each line led by the names of the records that reason refused (the same ADR-0079 resolver the success toast uses), up to three names and then `+N`;
  - a reason whose records have no name reads alone (the title already counts them);
  - at most three reasons, then "And N more";
  - an external datasource's refusal reads as the read-only sentence, as the one-record toast reads it;
  - a refusal with no message adds no line, so a batch with no reason at all keeps today's bare count toast.
  The one-record toast is unchanged.
- **`@object-ui/i18n`.** Two keys in all 11 packs: `objectActions.bulkDeleteRefusedNamed` (`{{names}}: {{reason}}`, with each pack's own colon) and `objectActions.bulkDeleteMoreReasons`. The name/reason join is allowlisted in `untranslated-identity-4376` as a format string, as `detail.fieldChangeLabel` is.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-view`.** The two keys join `ObjectView`'s `objectActions.*` fallback table.

## Decisions made here

- **Grouped by the exact reason text, named by record.** The card's own restrict example carries each record's dependent count in its sentence ("referenced by 3 records" / "by 1 record"), so records rarely share a byte-identical reason. Naming the records under each reason answers "which", which the acceptance allows ("reason, then how many records or which"); records that do share a reason are one line.
- **No counted noun in either new key.** "And {{more}} more" and the name list carry no plural noun, so no pack needs a CLDR plural family for them (`plural-categories-11432`). The option is `more`, not `count`, so i18next does not go looking for one.
- **The description is joined with `\n`,** as `writeWarningToast` and `studioSaveBar` do. Each reason the server sends ends in its own punctuation.
- **Not in this PR:** the related list's inline bulk-delete outcome line (`plugin-detail` `RelatedList.tsx`, `bulkDeleteOutcome`) has the same count-only shape, and a view-declared `operation: 'delete'` bulk action (the card's "also seen") was not measured. Both are for the seat to file or fold.

## Verification

- `core/src/actions/__tests__/recordDelete.test.ts`: 6 new or changed cases, red on `main` and green here (6 red with `recordDelete.ts` reverted): an all-refused batch for one reason (names, `+1`), a mixed batch (two reasons, order kept, the deleted record not named), nameless records (reason alone), five reasons (three listed, "And 2 more"), an external-datasource refusal (read-only sentence), and the existing partial-failure case now with its description. Controls: refusals with no message keep the bare count with no description; the one-record refusal toast is unchanged.
- `plugin-view` `ObjectView.gridDelete-10383`: the registered object-view bulk Delete's partial-failure pin now also asserts the refusal reason rides in the description.
- `vitest` over `core/src/actions`, all `plugin-view` tests, `app-shell` `useObjectActions*` and all of `i18n` (1,867 passed, including key parity, plural categories and the untranslated-identity gate): green. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` for `core`: clean. `eslint` on the changed files: 0 errors.
- `overlap-check`: exit 0 (#37676 and #37366 share the locale packs and merge cleanly).
- Premise: static read on `main` cac93cc627 (the bulk branch reads no rejected `reason`), and the red tests above.
